_comment: Which user-visible flags must be all-or-nothing across the live sites.
RULE FOR `forbidden`: use the SHORTEST distinguishing token, never a phrase.
On 8 August a grep for 'join waitlist' returned zero while 'Join THE Waitlist'
sat on the homepage hero. A phrase proves only that one wording is absent;
the bare token 'waitlist' cannot be evaded by a rewording.
RULE FOR `markers`: something that appears ONLY in that mode. Avoid strings
that double as ordinary copy — 'Get started' is a marker of purchase mode, but
'Ready to get started?' is a heading that exists in both, which is why it is
not listed as forbidden in waitlist mode.
